text: (1) seat_commit.py now drops a leading byte order mark of the message, from -m, -F <file> and -F - alike, and hands git the message on standard input as bytes (a text-mode pipe would write CRLF on Windows); test test_a_byte_order_mark_does_not_enter_the_message, watched failing on HEAD's tool first. Stripping rather than refusing: a mark is never part of a message, and refusing would only make the seat rewrite the file. (2) Yes: end-session now says that when other seats share the folder and git status shows paths that are not yours, the suites are run on an export of HEAD unpacked in a scratchpad folder short enough on Windows for the repository's longest paths, with your own changed files copied over, and the report names the tree; the gate needs no export, since the hook judges the commit's tree. office-12-landed says so.
